findings.title: Remove rejected historicalEffects data from the held compact payload
findings.evidence: Starting with a real qualified bound681 raw context, add historicalEffects.privateRaw='PRIVATE_SCHEMA_SENTINEL'. compactGitWorkContext clones the entire historicalEffects object before validation at line442. The new strict validator correctly rejects the unknown field with INVALID_COMPACT_SCHEMA and returns status held, but the catch path clears strings/sources/normative/decisions/task and retains that rejected historicalEffects clone. JSON.stringify(returnedHeldContext) still contains PRIVATE_SCHEMA_SENTINEL and the unknown privateRaw key. Public decoder rejection and safe hold reason text do not suppress the returned payload field.
findings.impact: Malformed source-context data can be echoed to a native-facing held result despite the schema/privacy rejection. Consumers may deliver held context for diagnosis, so the hold is not itself a confidentiality boundary. This is an independently demonstrated synthetic sentinel exposure in source QA; no actual private data or native leakage is claimed.
findings.requestedChange: Do not return an unvalidated wholesale historicalEffects clone on failure. Retain only explicitly validated owned history fields, or omit invalid history with an explicit unavailable/held outcome. Preserve valid completed/uncertain fences and existing safe held semantics. Add a negative asserting the serialized held result contains neither an unknown historical field nor its private sentinel.
findings.releaseCondition: An exact successor rejects the malformed historical schema without echoing rejected bytes, while valid historical counts/routes, safe error codes, replay holds and historical Task lineage still pass focused verification.
